title: TallPlan Forward Fold Fix
style: Paper craft layered cut-paper diorama with soft shadows, clean pastel studio background, warm upbeat fitness-ad look, consistent handcrafted paper textures, portrait 2:3 composition.
character: Same adult character in every slide: 19–20 years old, friendly expression, fully clothed in a fitted teal tank top, navy athletic shorts, white ankle socks, simple sneakers, neat short dark hair, healthy average build.
voice: Upbeat, friendly, brisk, clear coaching energy.

exercises.name: FORWARD FOLD
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 paper craft layered cut-paper diorama, plain clean pastel background, no text, no letters, no numbers. Subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible. Same adult character viewed from a slight front three-quarter angle, standing in a forward fold on a simple mat. WRONG form: both feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, both knees locked straight, hips high but not hinging cleanly, pelvis tucked, spine deeply rounded into a C shape, upper back hunched, shoulders shrugged toward ears, neck bent, head hanging, arms dangling down with fingertips reaching toward the floor near the toes. Make the locked knees and rounded back clearly visible.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 paper craft layered cut-paper diorama, plain clean pastel background, no text, no letters, no numbers. Subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible. Same adult character, same camera angle and framing, standing on the same mat in the RIGHT forward fold. Both feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, knees softly bent, hips pushed back into a clear hinge, sit bones lifting, torso long and diagonal toward thighs, spine lengthened instead of rounded, shoulders relaxed away from ears, neck neutral, gaze toward the mat, hands resting lightly on the shins for support. Calm controlled stretch posture.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 paper craft layered cut-paper diorama, plain clean pastel background, no text, no letters, no numbers. Subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible. Same adult character on a simple mat in cow pose, side three-quarter view. Both palms press flat into the floor directly under shoulders, fingers spread, both knees on the floor directly under hips, shins and tops of feet resting on the mat. Belly gently drops toward the floor, chest pulls forward, tailbone tips upward, shoulder blades broad, elbows straight but soft, neck long, gaze slightly forward and down. Correct, controlled spinal extension.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 paper craft layered cut-paper diorama, plain clean pastel background, no text, no letters, no numbers. Subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible. Same adult character, same camera angle and framing, on the same mat in cat pose, clearly different from cow. Both palms press flat into the floor under shoulders, both knees on the floor under hips, shins and tops of feet on the mat. Spine rounds high upward like an arch, tailbone tucked under, belly drawn in, chin gently tucked toward chest, shoulder blades spread wide, arms pressing the floor away. Correct, controlled spinal flexion.

result: Portrait 2:3 paper craft layered cut-paper diorama, plain clean pastel background, no text, no letters, no numbers. Subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible. Same adult character standing tall and relaxed on the mat with great posture: feet hip-width and flat, knees soft, pelvis neutral, spine long, chest open, shoulders down and back, chin level, eyes forward, proud happy smile, one hand resting lightly on hip and the other relaxed by the side.

lines.hook: Most people fold by rounding and locking their knees.
lines.ex1: Soften your knees, hinge at hips, and lengthen your spine.
lines.ex2: Cat-cow warms your spine and helps posture feel fluid.
lines.takeaway: Move gently daily, then stand tall with ease.
